Hard work, love for what we do, and trust from clients, their families, and friends are what drive us. We are a registered provider that is fully compliant with NDIS regulations and standards.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the NDIS?

The National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) is an Australian Government scheme that funds supports for people with permanent and significant disability, helping them live more independently and take part in their community.

Who is eligible for the NDIS?

In general you need to be under 65 when you apply, live in Australia as a citizen, permanent resident or Protected Special Category Visa holder, and have a permanent and significant disability, or be a young child who needs early support.

How do I apply for the NDIS?

Call the NDIS on 1800 800 110 or complete an access request form, along with evidence of your disability from your treating health professionals. If you are not sure where to start, give us a call and we will talk you through it.

What types of support are available through the NDIS?

The NDIS can fund help with daily living, community participation, building skills and independence, transport, therapies, assistive technology and home modifications. What is funded depends on your individual needs and goals.

How is NDIS funding allocated?

Funding is based on the supports that are reasonable and necessary for your disability. The NDIA works out a budget from your support needs and goals, and your plan sets out how that funding can be used.

What is an NDIS plan?

Your plan is a document that sets out your goals, the supports you are funded for, how your funding is managed, and when your plan will be reviewed.

How do I choose a NDIS provider?

There are many NDIS providers to choose from. When selecting a provider, it's essential to consider their experience, reputation, and the types of services they offer.

Can I change my NDIS provider?

Yes. You have choice and control over who supports you. Check your service agreement for any notice period, then let your current provider know and arrange a start date with your new one.

What happens if I need additional support beyond my NDIS plan?

If your needs or circumstances change, you can contact the NDIA to ask for your plan to be changed or reassessed. A support coordinator can help you gather the information you will need.

How can I get more information about the NDIS?

Visit ndis.gov.au or call the NDIS on 1800 800 110. You are also welcome to contact us directly with any questions.
